يقتصدون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَصِدُونَ (yaqtaṣidūna) /jaq.ta.sˤi.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# يُقْتَصَدُونَ (yuqtaṣadūna) /juq.ta.sˤa.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
